earlier_endings_checked: No express revocation, supersession or own-terms end found in the held working texts searched (Cruden number search for EO:6613; targeted pattern grep of held pinakes/wikisource/hathi-gpo texts for the others).
rationale: Restores 29,976 sq ft of Hawaii Arsenal Reservation to the Territory of Hawaii for widening Middle Street, with a reversion proviso if unused or if use ceases. The transfer is executed on signing, but the surviving consequence (territorial use) and conditional reversion cannot be dated or shown ended from held texts; performance and later cessation are unevidenced. Original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved. Cruden found EO 5132 (1929-06-06), which cites 4455 as a modification of the Fort Shafter reservation; that shows 4455 was treated as effective in 1929 but is not a revocation, not evidence of use for street widening, and not a current predicate.
material_gaps: Whether the land was used to widen Middle Street, and whether use later ceased (triggering reversion).
Held current source for the land's status; OCR text needs page check against the ProQuest scan.
